name: dsh-preset-screen-control
description: DSH agent preset: operate a real Windows desktop — capture the live screen, overlay a true-coordinate grid, verify the target with a red crosshair, synthesize mouse and keyboard input, then capture the FULL screen again to confirm what the input actually did.

scripts.install-preset: node -e "console.log('Run install.ps1 (Windows) or install.sh (POSIX) from this directory.')"

dsh.note: This package ships a DSH agent preset, not a host-plane plugin. `dsh plugin add` installs npm dependencies into a profile and does NOT register a preset — the preset directory must be placed under ${DSH_HOME}/.agent-presets/screen-control/. Use install.ps1 / install.sh.
